The record states that Sierra Outfitters, Inc considered less-intrusive alternatives as follows: only the fields on the credit application and the bureau report are processed — identity, income, tenure, and account references — with browsing history, purchase history outside the financed order, and marketing profiles excluded by design. This documented data-minimisation choice is the operative statement for the alternatives element of the balancing frame under 11 CCR § 7152(a)(3) and the overall weighing under 11 CCR § 7152(a).
